title: LAC Storage Spare Parts Management Coordinator
description:
Responsibilities:
Spare Parts Coordination & Shipments
Coordinate spare parts & tools requirements with Service, Operations, HQ, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate spare parts shipments, from shipment request and preparation through delivery, ensuring timely execution and proper follow-up.
Coordinate with freight forwarders, warehouses, suppliers, and internal teams as required for each shipment.
Monitor open spare parts requests, shipments, and deliveries, identifying potential delays or issues.
Ensure the required information and documentation is available for spare parts shipments.
Support urgent spare parts requirements and coordinate the necessary actions to meet project and service needs. Â
Coordinate the shipment of spare parts and tools between project sites, warehouses, and other locations as required.
Coordinate the transfer and redistribution of spare parts and tools between sites based on operational and service needs.
Â  Â
Spare Parts Planning & Inventory
Maintain visibility of spare parts inventory, consumption, incoming supply, and expected requirements across LAC.
Support spare parts demand planning based on project and service requirements, installed base, and available consumption information.
Identify potential shortages, excess inventory, and replenishment needs.
Support the planning and allocation of spare parts between projects and locations when required.
Develop and maintain basic reports and KPIs to support inventory and demand visibility.

Regional Spare Parts Development
Support the development and continuous improvement of the spare parts strategy for LAC.
Analyze spare parts requirements and operational information to identify improvement opportunities.
Support the definition of appropriate stock levels and replenishment criteria as regional operations develop.
Contribute to the standardization and improvement of spare parts processes across the region.
Support the development of tools and processes that improve spare parts visibility, planning, and control.

Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business/Commercial Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
0â2 years of experience. Â Previous experience in spare parts, supply chain, international trade, inventory management, or operations is desirable.
Advanced Excel skills.
Knowledge of Power BI and other data analysis tools is desirable.
Interest in developing skills in demand planning, inventory management, and data analysis.
Advanced English and Spanish.
